entry.title: InCad 0.11.1: Work Axis and point picking fixes
entry.content:
Fixed

  • Work Axis ▸ Axis of a cylinder on part of a cylinder or on a cone is the surface's own axis (it came out across the part).
  • Every Point field of the work features lights the part's marked points; the view turns while points are picked.
  • Hide / Show (Show All Origin too) no longer rebuilds the whole part: no lag on parts with embossed text.
